info.prompt: The last hacker-monk of the neon cathedral presses glowing fingers against a void-black prayer wheel, his skeletal gold cybernetic arm trembling as each rotation sends pulses of electric magenta through the synaptic floor tiles, illuminating ancient dice frozen in mid-air beneath the chapel’s central chandelier—its thousand cyan glass shards humming at 140BPM as they slowly invert into a descending guillotine of razor-code.
